summary: Phase 2 multi-case architecture testing completed. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend features verified: login, inbox with 4 conversations showing correct case counts/pending/unclassified badges, 3-column layout, case detail panel with status/agent/notes/history, case creation modal, message selection mode, filter buttons, i18n (CA/ES/EN), dashboard with case-centric metrics, agents page.

issues: Pere Martinez shows '1 sense classificar' badge but no longer has unclassified messages after test case creation linked the message

backend: GET /api/conversations - lists 4 conversations with case enrichment (cases_count, pending_cases, unclassified_count, derived_status)
GET /api/conversations/{id} - returns conversation with cases array (Maria Lopez has 2 cases)
GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages - returns messages with needs_classification field
POST /api/cases - creates case with title, description, priority, initial_note, message_ids
GET /api/cases/{id} - returns case detail with message_count
PATCH /api/cases/{id}/status - changes status (per_atendre, en_atencio, esperant_client, resolt, tancat)
GET /api/dashboard/metrics - returns case-centric metrics (new_today, per_atendre, en_atencio, esperant_client, unclassified_msgs, multi_case_convs, cases_by_agent, resolved_by_agent)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 multi-case architecture fully tested. Key features: 1) Each conversation can have multiple cases, 2) Messages can be classified/linked to cases, 3) Cases have full CRUD with status workflow (nou, per_atendre, en_atencio, esperant_client, resolt, tancat), 4) Case notes and events (audit trail) working, 5) Dashboard shows case-centric metrics, 6) i18n supports CA/ES/EN. The conversation list shows case counts, pending counts, and unclassified message counts. The detail panel has Cases and Info tabs. Selection mode allows selecting messages to create cases or link to existing cases.
